interpretation: Adds one shoulder-only axial control, 84 retargeted keys and four retained tracks; no extra geometry or draw surfaces.
The additional first-actor retained static allocation is 12,653 bytes and includes shared caches; it is not per-instance memory or VRAM.
Timings from two fresh processes overlap and vary with scheduling/background activity. Do not infer a speedup from the lower Ground Pound median.
Animation advance and forced bone transforms were measured at 240 updates per second, nine batches of 1,200 updates after warmup. GPU rendering and whole-game FPS were not benchmarked.
The correction changes shoulder axial roll only. Existing fast elbow aim remains; this is not a claim of fully reauthored physical motion.
